title: Israeli strikes kill 16 schoolchildren so far this month, Gaza ministry says
summary_full: Statement follows death of sisters, aged 15 and 13, in airstrike on residential apartment in Gaza CityIsraeli strikes have killed at least 16 schoolchildren in Gaza since the start of November, as young people across the territory face intensifying bombardment and struggle to find food, clean water and shelter.On Wednesday, Gaza’s ministry of education said: “Palestinian students had been targeted for the third time in less than 24 hours, in an escalation reflecting the continued Israeli violations against children in the Gaza Strip.” Continue reading...
